verdict.rationale: Casium publishes a public visa-guide library ('Every visa, explained. Reviewed by licensed immigration attorneys') with per-visa guides on routes relevant to founders (O-1A, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, H-1B). A blog guide to the International Entrepreneur Parole, the US startup-founder route, covers its eligibility criteria and application process, and an EB-1A piece breaks down the criteria. Missing for 10: evidence of real case examples, explicit confirmation that the guides are ungated rather than behind lead capture, coverage of startup visas outside the US despite the 90-country claim, and independent corroboration of guide depth.
